subjects.name: synthetic tree at both read caps: 2,000 named files, 16,776,000 bytes
subjects.generator:
# 2,000 TypeScript files in 20 units, 8,388 bytes each (2,000 x 8,388 = 16,776,000, within 16,777,216): 40 import statements each, then code.
for u in range(20):
    os.makedirs(f'u{u:02d}/src', exist_ok=True)
    open(f'u{u:02d}/package.json','w').write('{ "name": "@s/u%02d" }\n' % u)
for k in range(2000):
    u=k%20
    lines=[]
    for j in range(40):
        t=(k+j+1)%2000; tu=t%20
        lines.append(f"import {{ v{j} }} from '../../u{tu:02d}/src/f{t:04d}.js';" if j%2==0 else f"import {{ w{j} }} from '@s/u{(u+j)%20:02d}';")
    body='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
    filler='export const value = (a: number, b: number): number => (a + b) / 2; // filler\n'
    while len(body.encode())+len(filler) <= 8388: body+=filler
    body+= ' '*(8388-len(body.encode())-1)+'\n'
    open(f'u{u:02d}/src/f{k:04d}.ts','w').write(body)
# then: git init, git add -A, git commit (user t, t@example.invalid)
